review.decision: Verify clear, association and pane read boundaries in each reader
review.notes: Exercise fresh synthetic HTTP in Chromium and mounted mobile screen entry points. Keep bound-session, held-frame and access recovery controls. No native device claim.

cases.description: Clear retires a frozen Live frame before the first new turn
cases.setup: Freeze and resize a working pane on a narrow page or desktop tile.
cases.action: Read an empty transcript, then an explicit reset; reopen and poll the same reset again.
cases.expected: Plain empty history preserves the reader. A new reset drops old output and sizes; repeated metadata preserves the reopened reader.

cases.description: Live remains usable when history association is unavailable
cases.setup: Freeze observed Live in each web layout.
cases.action: Withdraw the observation and serve repeated unassociated transcript responses while pane reads succeed.
cases.expected: A fresh folded control exposes only the current pane and remains open on subsequent association failures.

cases.description: An observed session owns its mobile Live height and disclosure
cases.setup: Open and resize captured output in HQ and Detail.
cases.action: Update observation confidence, then switch the observed session in the same pane.
cases.expected: Confidence updates retain the reader; a new session starts closed and reopens at the default height.

cases.description: Pane access and absence have distinct mobile messages
cases.setup: Open the Live pane in HQ and Detail with authorized content.
cases.action: Return 401, 403 or 404, then a successful empty capture.
cases.expected: Old rows disappear. The message distinguishes denied access, a missing pane and a successful empty read.
